about_the_game:
KEY FEATURES

  • A Strategic, Turn-Based Puzzle Game.

  • Minimalistic, challenging and telegraphed gameplay that is easy to pick up.

  • Hand-crafted levels and a variety of unique tile types.

  • Tactile and explosive, with hand drawn pixel art and an ominous soundtrack.

ABOUT XENOSPORE

  • The Xenospore spreads and mutates predictably each turn.

  • Destroy tiles to isolate cities from the Xenospore fungus.

  • Cleanse infected cities before they are consumed.

  • Activate technology tiles to protect cities.

  • Isolate volatile facilities before they explode or mutate.

  • You can only act upon tile groups of the same type.

  • Outsmart the infection by leveraging its spread to eradicate larger areas.

short_description: Defend humanity against a creeping alien fungus in this strategic, turn-based puzzle game. Destroy tiles to isolate the Xenospore organism and protect populations in a minimalistic yet challenging experience.
